description: This file contains implementations of private API functions related to device information such as Model Name, Serial Number, and Hardware Version, for the COSA Data Model Library in a C-based environment.
external_methods: ANSC_STATUS CosaDmlDiGetSerialNumberPriv(ANSC_HANDLE hContext, char* pValue, ULONG* pulSize)
ANSC_STATUS CosaDmlDiGetHardwareVersionPriv(ANSC_HANDLE hContext, char* pValue, ULONG* pulSize)

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaDmlDiGetModelNamePriv(UCHAR * pValue)
methods.description: Sets the provided buffer to 0 and returns success; intended to retrieve device model name.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaDmlDiGetSerialNumberPriv(ANSC_HANDLE hContext,char * pValue,ULONG * pulSize)
methods.description: Sets the size to 0 and returns success; intended to retrieve device serial number.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaDmlDiGetHardwareVersionPriv(ANSC_HANDLE hContext,char * pValue,ULONG * pulSize)
methods.description: Sets the size to 0 and returns success; intended to retrieve hardware version.
